verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community benchmark of `ollama run` with 4-bit quantized variants of one model (q4_K_M, int4, plus nvfp4). That shows Ollama runs integer-quantized models, but nothing documents the range from very low-bit to 8-bit or how the quantization reduces memory. Missing for 10: first-party docs on supported quantization levels, evidence of very-low-bit (2–3 bit) and 8-bit options, memory-footprint figures, and a way for users to choose or create quantizations.
